note: Nauru's one bank is the Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CommBank), and it offers a person there no credit card. CommBank's Nauru page (read 2026-10-31) says it established banking operations in Nauru following the exit of the existing banking provider, and the Government of Naoero's Department of Finance says it operates the CommBank agency that provides banking services to Nauruan residents, open since 11 August 2025. CommBank's Transaction, Savings and Investment Account Terms and Conditions (dated 1 October 2026), in its Addendum for Nauruan customers (section N.2, Products and services available to you), says the full suite of CommBank products isn't available to a Nauruan customer, who may open only two personal products: Streamline Basic (an everyday account with a Debit Mastercard) and NetBank Saver, an online savings account. Neither is a credit card, so no bank in Nauru offers a person one. The notice at the front of the same document amends the addendum from 1 November 2026 only to rename Nauru 'Naoero'; nothing in it adds a product. A Nauruan who moves to Australia opens an Australian customer profile instead, under Australia's terms, which this file doesn't cover. Reading: that CommBank is the only bank rests on its own page's 'the existing banking provider' (one provider, which left) and the Department of Finance's agency page; no page found says 'the only bank' in so many words.

sources.said: If you create a CommBank Customer profile in Nauru, you will be considered a Nauruan customer. ... N.2. Products and services available to you ... Our full suite of CommBank products is not available to you. As a Nauruan customer, you will only be eligible to open the following personal products with features tailored to Nauruan Accounts: – Streamline Basic; and – NetBank Saver. ... All references to ‘Nauru’ updated to ‘Naoero’. All references to ‘Nauruan’ updated to ‘Dei-Naoero’.

sources.title: Commonwealth Bank of Australia, CommBank Naoero: How Naoero customers can access banking services with CommBank
sources.said: Streamline Basic, an everyday account for individual customers, with access to NetBank and Debit Mastercard ... NetBank Saver, an online savings account for individuals ... Following the exit of the existing banking provider, and the recent announcement of a Treaty between the Governments of Australia and Nauru, CommBank will establish banking operations in Nauru. ... our full suite of CommBank products is not available to Nauruan customers

sources.title: Government of Naoero, Department of Finance, Commonwealth Bank of Australia (the CommBank agency)
sources.said: The Department of Finance (representing the Republic of Naoero) operates an agency of the Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CommBank) in Naoero to provide banking services to Nauruans residents ( Agency ), supporting the Government of Naoero’s financial inclusion objectives. The Agency commenced operations on 11 August 2025.
